title: Encina Power Station

terrainReference.basis: Original present-day terrain on the west plant service apron; historical grades are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: USDA FSA August 2018 native 0.6 m aerial projection with the named Encina parcel in OpenStreetMap.
mapIdentity.scope: Digitized turbine and boiler roof outlines and visible support structures from the original 2018 USDA orthophoto. A current named industrial parcel identifies the historical site. Local coordinates follow the power block’s long axis.

note: The California Energy Commission records an eight-storey, five-steam-unit plant with one stack replacing earlier stacks in 1978. Exact 2019 and 2010 released photos establish the ash-gray building, saw-stepped roof equipment and tapered pale concrete stack.
